arabic text: HAYE KIS BEKAS KA LASHA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: ALAS, WHOSE HELPLESS BODY LIES UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?

arabic text: KIS KO ZANJEERO NE JAKDA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: WHO IS IT THAT HAS BEEN SHACKLED IN CHAINS UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?

arabic text: HAYE KIS BEKAS KA LASHA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: ALAS, WHOSE HELPLESS BODY LIES UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?

arabic text: BE-WATAN MAZLOOM KI HAI LASH-E-BE-GOR-O-KAFAN\nPHIR SE MANZAR KARBALA KA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: IT IS THE BODY OF A HOMELESS, OPPRESSED ONE, WITHOUT A GRAVE OR A SHROUD.\nONCE AGAIN, THE SCENE OF KARBALA IS BEING REPEATED UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD.

arabic text: HAYE KIS BEKAS KA LASHA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: ALAS, WHOSE HELPLESS BODY LIES UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?

arabic text: KYUN NA ROYE BAAL BIKHRAYE HUE HOORAN-E-KHULD\nFATIMA KE DIL KA TUKDA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: WHY WOULD THE MAIDENS OF PARADISE NOT WEEP WITH DISHEVELED HAIR?\nA PIECE OF FATIMA’S HEART LIES UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD.

arabic text: HAYE KIS BEKAS KA LASHA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: ALAS, WHOSE HELPLESS BODY LIES UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?

arabic text: QAID MEIN JISNE GUZARE UMR KE CHAUDA BARAS\nHAYE USI QAIDI KA LASHA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: HE WHO SPENT FOURTEEN YEARS OF HIS LIFE IN IMPRISONMENT\nALAS, IT IS THE BODY OF THAT SAME PRISONER UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD.

arabic text: HAYE KIS BEKAS KA LASHA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: ALAS, WHOSE HELPLESS BODY LIES UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?

arabic text: DEEN KA WAARIS HAI ISKI LASH UTHANE KE LIYE\nKAUN MAZDOORON KO LAYA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: THE HEIR OF THE RELIGION IS HERE TO LIFT HIS HOLY BODY,\nYET, WHO HAS BROUGHT THESE LABORERS TO THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?

arabic text: HAYE KIS BEKAS KA LASHA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: ALAS, WHOSE HELPLESS BODY LIES UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?

arabic text: SHEHR-E-KUFA KI TARAH, DARBAR-E-SHAMI KI TARAH\nZULM PHIR CHEHRA DIKHATA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: JUST LIKE THE CITY OF KUFA, JUST LIKE THE COURT OF DAMASCUS,\nOPPRESSION SHOWS ITS FACE ONCE AGAIN UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD.

arabic text: HAYE KIS BEKAS KA LASHA HAI PUL-E-BAGHDAD PAR
english translation text: ALAS, WHOSE HELPLESS BODY LIES UPON THE BRIDGE OF BAGHDAD?
